takes.text: Welcome.
In this course, you will learn what red light therapy is, what exercise recovery research reports, why protocols are hard to compare, and how to discuss this service honestly and within scope.

chosen.text: Photobiomodulation or PBM uses red or near-infrared light applied to the body.

takes.text: Reviews describe proposed effects on cellular metabolism, oxidative stress, and inflammatory signalling, but protocol differences make simple explanations difficult.
